title: Suspected broken ankle at a football stadium
setting: Football stadium catering area. Fan fell over seats while celebrating, suspected broken ankle, pain 8/10, friends think he is fine.
verdictExplanation: Suspected broken ankle, pain 8/10, pale/sweating, and hypotension (90/65). Sick: immediate immobilization and 999.

shared.circulation: Skin is pale, cold, and sweaty

history.history: Tripped over and twisted ankle in stadium seats while celebrating a goal 10 minutes ago
history.pmh: Broke other ankle a year ago
history.drugs: Allergic to penicillin, took antihistamine for hay fever today
history.injuries: Broken right ankle, swelling, non-weight bearing

followUp.question: What is the priority first aid intervention for this suspected broken ankle?

options.text: Call 999, support and immobilize the ankle in a comfortable position, and do not allow weight-bearing
Encourage him to stand and walk to proof it is not broken
Apply a tourniquet above the ankle to reduce the pain
Let his friend take him to A&E by walking him to the car

followUp.explanation: Suspected broken ankle. Call 999 immediately. Support and immobilize the ankle in a comfortable position. Never allow weight-bearing or walking as it can worsen bone displacement.

levelFlags.cfaNotes: Call 999. Support ankle, keep at rest. Reassure patient.
levelFlags.erNotes: ACS protocol. Administer oxygen if SpO₂ <94%. Splint ankle in position of comfort. Monitor vitals closely, prepare AED in case of arrest.
